import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd(); r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'sources/companion-2019.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30); print('pdftotext exit',r.returncode,r.stderr); assert r.returncode==0
s=r.stdout
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/companion-2019.txt'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True); assert r.returncode==0
print(s[:28500])
